## Patches

Applied in name order from patches/ with patch -p1. patches/core_math_compat.h is force-included
into the three files on MSVC cl only (src/CMakeLists.txt); it maps the GCC builtins to the C99
functions and defines the macros the patches read. tools/revendor-core-math.sh --prove builds the
patched files on those fallback paths with gcc and compares them to unpatched CORE-MATH.

- 0001-sinf-msvc.patch (sha256 6c52fef8b9fb7293d4737d1737ffa3761cb361d420ce75258440ddb01e4379b5):
  Reason: MSVC cl has no unsigned __int128, so rbig gets the same four products as u64 pairs
  (core_math_mul64), and cl rejects the constant 0.0f/0.0f (error C2124), so the NaN return for
  an infinite argument becomes x - x. CORE_MATH_NO_BUILTIN_ROUNDEVEN sends the --prove gcc build down
  the roundeven fallback cl already takes upstream. Each change is keyed to a macro only
  patches/core_math_compat.h defines, so gcc, clang, clang-cl and MinGW compile upstream unchanged.
- 0002-cosf-msvc.patch (sha256 ca387122020eca86fb306acc7ca99b9e34f91f3d57395f261dff2ccae0e3fe00):
  Reason: MSVC cl has no unsigned __int128, so rbig gets the same four products as u64 pairs
